summary: Archery hunter climbing over a downed tree near North Decker Creek dislodged an arrow from his quiver; the broadhead fully embedded in his right calf. SAR gave medical direction by phone, then ground teams with UTVs, a CPW officer, and Reach 29 responded; with no landing zone in the Decker Fire burn scar, a Colorado Army National Guard UH-60 Blackhawk with two Alpine Rescue technicians hoisted the survivor and transferred him tail-to-tail to Reach 29 at a landing zone near US Hwy 285 on Poncha Pass.
location: Near North Decker Creek, northern San Luis Valley
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page.
